app.name: Manifold
app.tagline: Diagnostics and invoicing for HVAC technicians

builder.heading: Tap what you fixed
builder.subheading: The invoice description writes itself in professional English while you work.
builder.empty: Tap a part to start. Everything you pick shows up here, written and ready to copy.
builder.emptyMaintenance: On a maintenance call you do not have to tap anything — the description already lists everything you inspected. Add parts only if you replaced something.
builder.emptyDiagnostic: If you checked the system and everything was fine, the description already covers what you tested and that no fault was found.
builder.itemsOnTicket: {count, plural, =0 {no parts} one {# part} other {# parts}}
builder.causeHint: Pick the cause and it appears in the invoice findings.
builder.finishHint: Saves to history and opens a new one.

jobs.heading: Job history
jobs.empty: No saved jobs yet. Anything you do on the Work order tab saves itself, even with no signal.

equipment.heading: Photograph the nameplate
equipment.subheading: Take a photo of the data plate and the numbers fill themselves in. Check them, pick the floor and save; then copy it into ServiceTitan field by field.

scan.done: Done. Check the fields before saving.
scan.doneUncertain: Done. Check the highlighted fields — they were hard to read.
scan.offline: No signal. The photo is saved; fill the fields by hand or read it later.
scan.failed: Couldn't read the nameplate. Fill the fields by hand or try another photo.
scan.unreadable: The photo can't be read. Try closer, with light and no glare.
scan.notConfigured: Automatic reading isn't set up (API key missing). Fill the fields by hand.
scan.busy: The service is busy. Try again in a moment.

equipment.empty: No equipment yet. Photograph a nameplate to start; it saves on the phone even without signal.
equipment.age: {years, plural, =0 {under a year} one {# year} other {# years}}
